plain: An attack that needs some look inside the model, such as how likely it finds each word, but not its full internals.
eli5: You cannot open the toy, but you can watch the little lights that show how close you are.
technical: An attack that reads the target's output logits or loss but takes no gradients through it, as AutoDAN does to score candidate prompts; it needs a self-hosted open-weights model even though it never differentiates.
